::: {.callout-note}
FedRAMP 20x replaces the point-in-time ATO letter with a continuous stream of machine-readable Key Security Indicators. UIAO is positioned as the OrgPath-aware KSI emitter for the federal cloud authorization surface — because every KSI is only useful when it is precisely scoped to an organizational boundary, and OrgPath is what defines those boundaries deterministically.
:::
